title: The Dennis Trace for Assembler K-Theory
summary: We define a notion of Hochschild homology of a weak assembler and use it to construct a Dennis trace map from the group completion $K$-theory of a weak assembler to its Hochschild homology. We compute the Hochschild homology for some examples, in particular for various cases of restricted polytopes. We also give an explicit description of the Dennis trace map at level $0$, i.e. from the zeroth $K$-theory group to the zeroth Hochschild homology group.
